notes:
The toolbar Download button in MangaView now stores the filtered chapters and shows an alert titled "Download %i chapters?" with CANCEL and DOWNLOAD when LargeDownloadConfirmation.needsConfirmation holds. Cancel clears the stored chapters and queues nothing. DOWNLOAD calls the new private helper queueDownload(_:), which runs the Wi-Fi check and queues the chapters. Requests that don't need confirmation call the same helper. I found the work already committed on the branch (c0633d87) and only ran the gate, which was GREEN. Its only finding is a non-gating baseline lint nit.
